amendment_reason: The 2026-05-13 H4 pre-registration keyed the geometry/variance/calibration discrimination on the BHPS label-shuffle p approx 0.036. The 2026-05-25 [NEGATIVE] proved _label_shuffle / _cohort_shuffle are PH-row-order-invariant (vacuous): that p-value is landmark-subsampling noise, explicitly 'not a BHPS asymmetry'. The premise is void. This amendment replaces the vacuous label-shuffle null with a VALID frozen Markov-1 null, drops the geometry diagnostic (uninformative under a valid null, where the surrogate is a different point cloud by construction), and reframes the Task as POSITIVE credibility evidence for the BHPS Markov-1 W2 rejection.

entries.name: BHPS Markov-1 rejection credibility under valid nulls
entries.objective: Establish whether the BHPS Markov-1 W2 rejection is credible (not a calibration or variance-inflation artefact) using valid frozen-loadings nulls, and lock the P01-B section 4.2.3 prose direction.

calibration.construction: Double-null p-value uniformity under the frozen Markov-1 null: draw n_calibration_trials synthetic 'observed' BHPS samples from the frozen Markov-1 generator; for each, compute the mean-vs-mean T_ratio W2 p-value against a shared frozen Markov-1 null bank; collect the trial p-values; test their distribution against Uniform(0,1).
calibration.statistic: one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov of the n_calibration_trials p-values vs Uniform(0,1); report ks_statistic, ks_p, and mean_pvalue. A binned chi-square goodness-of-fit reported as a discreteness-robust companion (trial p-values are discrete at (r+1)/(B+1) resolution).

variance.construction: Null-null coefficient of variation (CV = sd/mean) of the frozen Markov-1 null-null W2 distances at L=5000 for BHPS and for USoc; reuse the cached frozen Markov-1 null diagrams from T1.37 (no fresh PH where a cache exists).

key_params.reuse_cache: T1.37 frozen Markov-1 null diagrams (BHPS + USoc) where present

decision_rule.credible: calibrated (ks_p >= 0.05) AND NOT variance_flag -> section 4.2.3 reports the BHPS Markov-1 rejection as credible; the earlier label-shuffle 'anomaly' is disclosed as an invalid-null (PH-invariant) artefact per the 2026-05-25 [NEGATIVE].
decision_rule.conditionally_credible: calibrated (ks_p >= 0.05) AND variance_flag (BHPS null-null materially tighter than USoc) -> section 4.2.3 reports the rejection with an explicit variance-inflation caveat.
decision_rule.suspect: NOT calibrated (ks_p < 0.05; the test deviates from uniform under its own null) -> section 4.2.3 must temper the BHPS rejection; report the direction of miscalibration (anti-conservative if mean_pvalue < 0.5 / excess mass near 0) and escalate to the User before locking prose.

entries.execution_guardrails: Long stochastic compute. Benchmark the per-trial W2 cost first; >=4-worker single reusable executor; checkpoint per trial; resumable; pause for Manager direction if the projection exceeds 12h at 4 workers (reduce calibration_null_bank_B toward the floor, or reuse more of the cached null bank). The variance diagnostic is near-free (cache reuse).

planned_contracts.required_keys: schema_version (str); generated_at (str); task ('T1.6 ...'); pre_registration (refs 2026-06-13 amendment); inputs (git_head + frozen null cache refs for BHPS and USoc); params (null_model=='markov-1', frozen_loadings==true, L==5000, seed==42, n_calibration_trials==100, calibration_null_bank_B>=100, p_value_formula=='(r+1)/(B+1)'); calibration (ks_statistic float>=0, ks_p float in [0,1], mean_pvalue float in [0,1], calibrated bool == (ks_p>=0.05)); variance (bhps_nullnull_cv float>0, usoc_nullnull_cv float>0, variance_flag bool == (bhps_nullnull_cv < 0.5*usoc_nullnull_cv)); decision (verdict in {credible, conditionally_credible, suspect} coupled: suspect iff NOT calibrated; conditionally_credible iff calibrated AND variance_flag; credible iff calibrated AND NOT variance_flag)
planned_contracts.binding: test_file tests/trajectory_tda/test_t1_6_markov1_credibility_contracts.py; must_assert rejects payloads where calibrated disagrees with ks_p>=0.05, variance_flag disagrees with the CV rule, decision.verdict disagrees with the coupling, any p/CV is out of range, or per_call_pca present (Worker authors the binding test, clears pending).
